serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities (service_bucket_*_available_minutes) for allocatedMin; each bucket's own source table for bookedMin; service_capacities service_bucket_*_reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is the per-bucket share of the lot's available service minutes. bookedMin is the authoritative load from each bucket's own table (orders -> capacity_bookings source_type='Order'; onFlexService -> maintenance_bookings total_estimated_minutes, whole job not remaining; unassignedService -> unassigned_services labor_minutes, status='active'). ledgerBookedMin is service_capacities' own reserved figure, kept alongside because it lags: on 2026-10-23 it read 366 for Stone Mountain day 1 against a true 726. null for a site/day means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series - the same ceiling applies to every day of the window; daily_order_capacity is the UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity'; null means not configured, not a ceiling of zero.
